0022600175.text: Boston is 5-2 and 4-0 at home through seven games, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East after a loss in its most recent game, while Milwaukee is 1-6, on a three-game losing streak, and 14th in the East. The Celtics are without Devin Carter (out, illness) and Jayson Tatum (out, rest), and the Bucks are without Kam Jones, who is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Boston won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 133-101 regular-season win in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026.
